Hi team — quick note on evidence types and logistics from Redwood Security:

1) Preferred transfer: PGP-encrypted tarballs to our SFTP endpoint (we'll provide host + user). Drive is allowed for docs but we ask for MFA-protected accounts and a limited sharing list.
2) Minimum acceptable artifacts for common controls:
   - Access control: IAM policy export + sample access reviews (CSV)
   - KMS: key rotation snapshot, KMS policy document, list of keys in scope
   - Logging: example log retention policy and 7-day extract for a representative service
   - Change management: change ticket export for last 90 days + approval matrix
3) For any items with PII, flag in the roster and we will limit access to the security team only.

I added a short checklist to the MAP workbook (Drive link below) and can run the first evidence intake session once we receive SAML metadata or SSO contact.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFghIJkL2-mocklink
